mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.trip_id, ts.trip_country_id, c.country_name, c.time_zone, ts.schedule_name, ts.scheduled_at, ts.amount, cur.currency_code, cur.symbol AS currency_symbol, ts.payment_status, ts.schedule_status, ts.place_name, ts.place_address FROM trip_schedules ts INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = ts.trip_id LEFT JOIN trip_countries tc ON tc.id = ts.trip_country_id AND tc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id LEFT JOIN currencies cur ON cur.id = COALESCE(ts.currency_id, c.currency_id) WHERE ts.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ts.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ts.scheduled_at ASC, ts.id ASC

SELECT ts.id, ts.trip_id, ts.trip_country_id, c.country_name, c.time_zone, ts.schedule_name, ts.scheduled_at, ts.amount, cur.currency_code, cur.symbol AS currency_symbol, ts.payment_status, ts.schedule_status, ts.place_name, ts.place_address, ts.memo FROM trip_schedules ts INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = ts.trip_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN trip_countries tc ON tc.id = ts.trip_country_id AND tc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id LEFT JOIN currencies cur ON cur.id = COALESCE( ts.currency_id, c.currency_id ) WHERE ts.id = #{scheduleId} AND ts.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ts.is_deleted = 0

SELECT tc.id AS trip_country_id, c.id AS country_id, c.country_name, c.time_zone, c.currency_id AS default_currency_id, cur.currency_code AS default_currency_code FROM trip_countries tc INNER JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id INNER JOIN currencies cur ON cur.id = c.currency_id WHERE tc.id = #{tripCountryId} AND tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_schedules ( trip_id, trip_country_id, currency_id, schedule_name, scheduled_at, amount, payment_status, schedule_status, place_name, place_address, memo ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{tripCountryId}, #{currencyId}, #{scheduleName}, #{scheduledAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{amount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{paymentStatus}, #{scheduleStatus}, #{placeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{placeAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_schedules SET trip_country_id = #{tripCountryId}, currency_id = #{currencyId}, schedule_name = #{scheduleName}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, amount = #{amount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, place_name = #{placeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, place_address = #{placeAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, memo = #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0
